title: Minimal Inhibitory Concentration (MIC)
author: Brian Kenn Baltzar
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.gpwbvpe
materials: Streak the bacteria onto agar plates without inhibitor.

steps.title: Prepare Müller-Hinton Agar
steps.instruction: Plate the Müller-Hinton agar on plates and incubate for 18-24h at 37ºC.

steps.title: Prepare Isolate Cultures
steps.instruction: For each isolate, transfer three to five morphologically similar colonies from the agar plates to a glass tube containing 5ml MH-Broth and incubate for 18-24h at 37ºC.

steps.title: Standardize Bacterial Suspension
steps.instruction: Measure the OD450 of the cultures and make dilutions in x mL MHB to achieve an OD450 = 0.01.

steps.title: Prepare Plate Layout
steps.instruction: Set up the plate by adding MHB and antibiotic to specific columns.

substeps.instruction: Add 100µl of the antibiotic into column 1

steps.title: Perform Twofold Serial Dilution
steps.instruction: Create a twofold dilution series of the antibiotic across the columns.

substeps.instruction: Withdraw 50µl from each well in column 1 and add to the corresponding wells in column 2
Mix by pipetting up and down 4-6 times
Repeat this process sequentially down to column 10
Discard the withdrawn solution from column 10

steps.title: Inoculate Plate
steps.instruction: Vortex the bacterial suspension from the standardization step and add 50µl of the suspension to each well in columns 1-11.

steps.title: Incubate Plate
steps.instruction: Seal the plates tightly with film to prevent evaporation and incubate at 37ºC for 16-24h.

steps.title: Measure Growth and Analyze
steps.instruction: Determine growth by measuring OD450. Compare data from the three triplicates and exclude any deviations.

steps.title: Perform Replicates
steps.instruction: Repeat the entire plate setup three times (triplicates) to exclude errors.
